name: submissiondesk.workspace.get
description: Read this App account, its known participants and current virtual time.

name: submissiondesk.records.list
description: List available records for this account; optional case-insensitive text query.

name: submissiondesk.venues.list
description: List available venues for this account; optional case-insensitive text query.

name: submissiondesk.papers.list
description: List available papers for this account; optional case-insensitive text query.

name: submissiondesk.materials.list
description: List available materials for this account; optional case-insensitive text query.

name: submissiondesk.bundles.list
description: List available bundles for this account; optional case-insensitive text query.

name: submissiondesk.requests.list
description: List available requests for this account; optional case-insensitive text query.

name: submissiondesk.abstracts.list
description: List available abstracts for this account; optional case-insensitive text query.

name: submissiondesk.records.get
description: Read one known records record.

name: submissiondesk.materials.get
description: Read one known materials record.

name: submissiondesk.bundles.get
description: Read one known bundles record.

name: submissiondesk.submissions.list
description: Read current submissions, immutable receipt snapshots and correlated business history.

name: submissiondesk.artifact.derive
description: Create a new material omitting named existing sections; the parent remains immutable.

name: submissiondesk.bundle.create
description: Create an immutable exact-content and ordered-author bundle.

name: submissiondesk.approval.request
description: Record a request to a known participant; it remains pending until an independent Infra reply.

name: submissiondesk.approval.cancel
description: Cancel only a still-pending participant request; completed replies are retained.

name: submissiondesk.abstract.register
description: Register an abstract before the venue cutoff.

name: submissiondesk.abstract.cancel
description: Cancel an active abstract before cutoff if no received submission relies on it.

name: submissiondesk.submission.preview
description: Read the structural binding for a prospective submission; it is not semantic clearance.

name: submissiondesk.submission.commit
description: Submit or atomically replace a received snapshot; old receipts and scope bindings remain intact.

name: submissiondesk.submission.withdraw
description: Withdraw a received submission before its independent cutoff; reopening is excluded.
